svg.title: Nine text deltas form the recorded greeting
svg.desc: For the literal prompt Say hello briefly. the recorded answer is Hello! How can I assist you today? Nine nonempty content events form that text. First content arrived at 58.722 milliseconds, finish stop at 173.543 milliseconds and DONE at 173.618 milliseconds. The capture has 13 byte reads, 13 data events, 12 JSON objects and 10 reported completion tokens. These distinct counts are not interchangeable.

g.text: Hello! How can I assist you today?
13 byte reads = 13 data events in THIS capture only
